Awards & Achievements

Kai Shing obtained "Diamond (Corporate) - PropTech Solution of the Year (Property Management)" in "PropTech Excellence Awards 2024"

Kai Shing Property Management Limited (Kai Shing) is dedicated to exploring innovative technologies and introducing innovative technological solutions to optimize property management for its managed properties. Recently, Kai Shing was honored with the "Diamond (Corporate) - PropTech Solution of the Year (Property Management)" in "PropTech Excellence Awards 2024" presented by the Hong Kong PropTech Association. The award recognizes Kai Shing's outstanding performance in driving property management technology.

On the day of the award ceremony, International Commerce Centre (ICC), a signature property under Kai Shing's management, was invited to share the deployment of the Augmented Reality (AR) solution in ICC to industry peers on stage. As one of the iconic buildings in Hong Kong, ICC actively adopts multiple innovative technologies and strives to become the tallest and greenest smart building in Hong Kong. To achieve energy-saving and carbon reduction goals, the ICC management team has incorporated Augmented Reality Maintenance Management (ARMM) into its operation by using 3D scanning technology to render a high accuracy 3D model with internal and external structures, so that the team can monitor and operate facilities virtually via an ARMM interface at all times. Besides, the new technology can also help our security officers to formulate a precise patrol routes, to strengthen the accuracy and safety of patrolling. The enhancement would help increase the overall quality of property management, while simultaneously create a safer and comfortable environment for customers.

Kai Shing is deeply honoured to receive this award. Leveraging rich experience in property management over the years, we have been actively seeking innovative solutions for different properties. With the goal of combining advanced technologies and innovative thinking to improve the quality of property management, we will continue to strive for creating an ideal living and working environment for those living in properties under Kai Shing's management.
